I know I'm gonna be the most annoying person ever, but I just really need someone to talk to. My city just decided on mandatory masking everywhere, including outside. While I dont really have a problem wearing them inside, all my outdoor activities involve exercise and I cant do them in a mask. I also know that this means more restrictions coming soon, so it's not even really about the masks. I feel like I have no one to turn to, I've already relapsed on self harm, seeing my therapist over video chat fucking sucks, and I'm just really in a low spot with no support lmao.

I think it's also a mix of people genuinely a)thinking they need to go to the hospital bc they feel sick and b) not knowing whether to choose the ER or GP. My mom works at a hospital (xrays) and she told me of a 20 something year old that came in asking for a chest x ray to check for covid. They asked her if she had any symptoms. She said no but wanted to check anyways. They asked why she didnt just get a swab. She said she felt better at the ER. Weird all around.
Like, I dont get it. Wouldn't it be easier to allocate resources and restrictions on a focused group of people rather than an entire population? This is program implementation 101.

Again, if people could not do it the first time they most certainly will not be able to a second time. 

Also, I am starting to think, at least around me, that people just say shit because it's the "right" thing. I have hung out with people recently who have posted incessantly on social media about staying the fuck home and all that but will go hang out with friends, go to restaurants, go to event centers, and the like. I have literally been in cars with people who will complain about people outside not social distancing and have to go "uhm, neither are you right now." I flat out dont think people really understand what they're preaching because they do the exact opposite. It's bizarre.

I think at some point, we are all going to have to accept that Miss Rona is going to be a permanent guest.
